raw_segments.text: As in decapitating the whale, the operator's instrument is brought close to the spot where
an entrance is subsequently forced into the spermaceti magazine.
He has, therefore, to be uncommonly heedful, lest a careless, untimely stroke should invade
the sanctuary and wasteingly let out its invaluable contents.
It is this decapitated end of the head, also which is at last elevated out of the water,
and retained in that position by the enormous cutting tackles, whose hempen combinations,
on one side, make quite a wilderness of ropes in that quarter.
